The catalog has no generic container, so I used a single-column `columns` component as the root and put the heading, the four KPI tiles (a `metric_row` with up/down trends) and the comparison bar chart inside it as nested blocks. The nested blocks carry both `type` and `component` keys because the catalog doesn't specify the block format.
